basePkgName.description: The base {@link Pkg} which should be modified to start the service.

basePkgVersion.description:
The version of the base pkg.

Optional for Server defined pkgs.

configurationParams.description:
The type(s) corresponding to the service(s) that should be configured. Note that these types must exist in the
{@link basePkg}. The key corresponds to the {@link Microservice.Service} type name, and the value is the json of
the corresponding {@link Microservice.Service#configurationType}.

env.description:
The {@link Env} to start the service(s) in. If not defined, the service will be deployed to the default
"microservice" environment.

title: The base configuration for starting a {@link Microservice} from UI.
name: Microservice.PkgConfiguration
